items.title: Employment Gap Penalty Loop
items.summary: An initial gap in employment triggers automated ATS downranking, resulting in fewer interview invitations, which extends the employment gap.
items.content:
# Employment Gap Penalty Loop

An initial gap in employment triggers automated ATS downranking, resulting in fewer interview invitations, which extends the employment gap.

### Cycle Dynamics
This causal loop reinforces mechanisms across iterations:
- `M-011` amplifies `M-008`
- `M-008` amplifies `M-009`
- `M-009` amplifies `M-011`

items.title: Inflated-Requirements Search Saturation Loop
items.summary: Teams write inflated requirements, filtering out strong generalists, prolonging open search, causing recruiter fatigue and mid-process role redefinitions.
items.content:
# Inflated-Requirements Search Saturation Loop

Teams write inflated requirements, filtering out strong generalists, prolonging open search, causing recruiter fatigue and mid-process role redefinitions.

### Cycle Dynamics
This causal loop reinforces mechanisms across iterations:
- `M-024` amplifies `M-008`
